data.narrative:
Orchard Robotics is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $25.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Humanoid, and Walden Robotics), supplemented by reference to 8 additional private comparables and 1 public peer, providing reasonable coverage of the frontier-robotics landscape.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised ($26M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implies a valuation of $52M. Peer-median analysis across the 5-company reference set yields a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range from $1.1B (Walden Robotics, seed stage) to $2.0B (Generalist AI, Series B). The peer approach reflects stage and sector heterogeneity; later-stage comparables pull the median upward.

Synthesizing these methods produces a triangulated range of $44M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $851M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether Orchard's trajectory and market position more closely align with earlier-stage or later-stage peer valuations. Key uncertainties include commercialization traction, competitive differentiation relative to the named peer set, and whether frontier-robotics valuations have sustained recent corrections.
